duzeltme.govde: For a production line, the proportion of defective items is $p = 0.05$. A random sample of $n$ items will be taken. What is the smallest sample size for which the large counts condition is satisfied, so that the sampling distribution of the sample proportion is approximately normal?

2. $np\ge10$ → $n\ge10/0.05=200$.
3. $n(0.95)\ge10$ → $n\ge10.53$. İkisi birlikte: en küçük $n=200$.
duzeltme.hata_aciklamalari.A.aciklama: $n(0.95)\ge10$ ise $n\ge10.53$, yani 11 olur; ama $np\ge10$ koşulu da gerekir ve o $n\ge200$ ister.
duzeltme.hata_aciklamalari.D.aciklama: $0.05\times20=1$; beklenen başarı sayısı 10 değil 1 olur. Doğru: $10/0.05=200$.

duzeltme.secenekler[1].text: In repeated random samples of 250 adults, the sample proportion who ride weekly typically differs from 0.20 by about 0.025.

duzeltme.hata_aciklamalari.C.aciklama: Parametre 0.20 olarak verilmiştir; 0.025 örneklem oranlarının bu değer etrafındaki tipik sapmasıdır.

duzeltme.secenekler[1].text: The probability of a sample proportion of 0.87 or lower is about 0.002, so there is a 0.002 probability that the claim is true.
duzeltme.secenekler[2].text: The probability of a sample proportion of 0.87 or lower is about 0.43, so the sample gives no reason to doubt the claim.

duzeltme.secenekler[0].text: There is convincing evidence that more than half of all residents support the change, but not that more than 55% do.
duzeltme.secenekler[1].text: There is convincing evidence that more than half of all residents support the change and that more than 55% do.
duzeltme.secenekler[2].text: There is not convincing evidence for either claim, because the interval has a width of 0.08 and is too wide.

duzeltme.govde: A supplier claims that at most 8% of its light bulbs are defective. A quality inspector suspects the defect rate is higher. In a random sample of 500 bulbs, 52 are defective. She tests $H_0: p = 0.08$ versus $H_a: p \gt 0.08$ at $\alpha = 0.01$. Which of the following correctly summarizes the test?
duzeltme.secenekler[0].text: $z \approx 1.98$, p-value $\approx 0.024$; reject $H_0$, so there is convincing evidence that the defect rate is greater than 0.08.
duzeltme.secenekler[1].text: $z \approx 1.98$, p-value $\approx 0.976$; fail to reject $H_0$, so there is not convincing evidence that the defect rate is greater than 0.08.
duzeltme.secenekler[2].text: $z \approx 1.76$, p-value $\approx 0.039$; fail to reject $H_0$, so there is not convincing evidence that the defect rate is greater than 0.08.
duzeltme.secenekler[3].text: $z \approx 1.98$, p-value $\approx 0.024$; fail to reject $H_0$, so there is not convincing evidence that the defect rate is greater than 0.08.
duzeltme.aciklama:
1. $\hat{p}=52/500=0.104$; koşullar: $np_0=40$, $n(1-p_0)=460$ ≥ 10.
2. $z=(0.104-0.08)/\sqrt{0.08(0.92)/500}\approx0.024/0.0121\approx1.98$; p-value $=P(Z\ge1.98)\approx0.024$.
3. 0.024 > 0.01 → fail to reject $H_0$; hata oranının 0.08'den büyük olduğuna dair ikna edici kanıt yok.
duzeltme.genel_hatirlatma: Karar, önceden seçilen α'ya göre verilir; 0.024 α = 0.05'te anlamlı, α = 0.01'de değil.
duzeltme.hata_aciklamalari.A.aciklama: α = 0.01 seçilmiş; 0.024 > 0.01 olduğundan $H_0$ reddedilmez.
duzeltme.hata_aciklamalari.B.aciklama: $H_a:p\gt0.08$ için p-değeri sağ kuyruktur: $P(Z\ge1.98)\approx0.024$.
duzeltme.hata_aciklamalari.C.aciklama: SD $p_0=0.08$ ile hesaplanmalı: $\sqrt{0.08(0.92)/500}\approx0.0121$; $\hat{p}$ ile hesaplanan $0.0137$ değil.
